en:
This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy.

It is now 10 p.m.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL> officially starts now.

Staying up late is bad for your skin, so maybe
you bastards should go to bed, okay?

The reason I can't sleep is because I'm up
all night thinking about you, Monophanie.
Ba-dump!

Wh-What...? You...can't just blurt out
something like that.

It's kinda crazy, really... I've never thought
about you this way before...

Hey...when did you worm your way into
my heart?
Ba-dump!
So...what are you gonna do about this?

We can't... We're family, y'know?
You can't...forget that...
I need you, Monophanie.
I want you, Monotaro.
<CLT=cltMIND>What was *that*...?

Well, no point worrying about the Monokubs.
It's time for training!

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like I haven't done it in a
long time... Alright, to the courtyard!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed is starting to feel more comfortable,
I just might prefer it over futons...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>So many identical uniforms
in my closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of preparation must mean
that they were targeting us.
